b_sub_chunk_join.why: sp.run is one synchronous, layer-major pass over a segment list fixed by set_segments before the run, and the serve loop (admission, lending, setups) is blocked inside it. A reader arriving mid-chunk cannot share the layers already passed; joining at a sub-step means its own pass for those layers, so the shared expert pass (C0) is not saved. The nearest buildable form, starting the next chunk without the decode share, simulates as no gain (share 0: window parts/chunk 1.05, -0.11 s a turn).
